title: Sub-Scope Report Contribution Delivery
summary: establish a generic optional contribution boundary for manage-only docs_subscope row and toolbar behavior without changing its public reader
content_html:
Sub-Scope Report Contribution Delivery

Status And Order

Delivered as SSI-1, the first implementation delivery for Sub-Scope Index.

SSI-1 passed its public/manage isolation and realistic list/detail review. SSI-2 and SSI-3 remain proposed and have not started.

Complete Outcome

The shared docs_subscope report accepts an optional, caller-supplied contribution contract for:

  • list-row adornments;
  • a list toolbar;
  • a detail toolbar on the same header row as Back; and
  • mount, state-change, refresh, and unmount notifications.

The manage bridge supplies the contribution. Public callers supply nothing, render no empty hosts, and do not import the management controller or any workflow module.

The existing manage-only Status and non-viewable icons move behind the row contribution boundary without changing their appearance or data source. This gives SSI-1 a real behavior-preserving refactor outcome rather than shipping unused visible controls.

Change Classification

kind work
shipped and retained public manifest/list/detail navigation; manage inventory; existing Status/non-viewable icon behavior; validated detail state
shipped extension shared report accepts optional hosts and explicit contribution callbacks
shipped refactor manage-only row semantics moved out of the public shared report and into one focused manage controller
genuinely new user workflow none

SSI-1 is an enabling delivery. It does not claim Delete, checkboxes, selection, or Prepare Package as shipped.

Contribution Contract

The shared report remains the only owner of:

  • configured sub-scope validation;
  • list membership and ordering;
  • row and detail navigation;
  • subdoc URL state;
  • by-ID identity validation;
  • public-safe rendering; and
  • the current exact detail target.

When a contribution is supplied, the report passes only explicit values:

collection: { scope, sub_scope }
row:        collection + document record + row host
detail:     { scope, sub_scope, doc_id } + detail toolbar host
state:      list | loading | detail | invalid | error | unmounted

The manage controller owns capability checks, management presentation, action definitions, workflow loading, busy state, and reconciliation. It never reads subdoc to invent a target, scrapes report markup, or falls back to the selected parent document.

Hosts exist only when the contribution requests content. Public mode and a manage contribution with no applicable control produce no blank toolbar or layout gap.

Rows, accessible control state, and contribution handoffs retain exact doc_id. Title remains ordinary display data and is not validated for uniqueness.

In Scope

  • Define the smallest generic contribution interface required by the three approved host positions and lifecycle events.
  • Keep the shared report free of management imports.
  • Move existing Status/non-viewable row adornment behavior behind the manage-only contribution.
  • Retain one compact inventory read; do not fetch one full record per row.
  • Add manage-only presentation for contribution hosts.
  • Preserve list/detail navigation, Back/Forward, explicit Back, and contained invalid-detail behavior.
  • Cover missing Status, non-viewable rows, empty lists, failed inventory, remount, and unmount.
  • Prove the public asset/import graph excludes the controller and future action/workflow modules.

Not In Scope

  • Delete or any other mutation.
  • Checkboxes, selection state, or package preparation.
  • Moving existing global Source, Edit metadata, or Open in VS Code controls into the report header.
  • Public Status/non-viewable icons.
  • New public payload fields.
  • Filtering, search, bulk actions, or Tag Registry data.
  • A generic contribution framework for every report type.

Delivery Tracker

[x] SSI-1.0 — Freeze The Seam And Baseline

  • [x] Record the exact shared report, manage bridge, inventory, icon, state callback, CSS, and public bootstrap owners.
  • [x] Add missing-Status, non-viewable, empty, and invalid-detail fixtures.
  • [x] Capture focused baseline evidence for public list/detail navigation, manage inventory/icon rendering, and public module isolation.
  • [x] Confirm the smallest host/callback shape before runtime edits.

Review gate: approve the contribution shape and baseline omissions before changing row ownership.

[x] SSI-1.1 — Add Optional Shared Hosts

  • [x] Add row, list-toolbar, and detail-toolbar host support without importing management code.
  • [x] Mount the detail toolbar in the header row containing Back, only after the by-ID payload identity has been validated.
  • [x] Publish explicit collection, row, detail, lifecycle, and refresh inputs.
  • [x] Render no host or spacing when no contribution supplies content.
  • [x] Preserve current report state, URL, focus, and error behavior.

Review gate: shared report tests prove optional composition and unchanged public behavior before the manage controller is connected.

[x] SSI-1.2 — Move Manage Row Semantics

  • [x] Add one focused manage controller through the existing manage bridge.
  • [x] Render Status and non-viewable icons from the compact inventory.
  • [x] Remove management-specific icon interpretation from the shared report.
  • [x] Preserve accessible names and exact row IDs.
  • [x] Verify ordinary and narrow layouts without adding future action controls.

Review gate: tactile review confirms that the behavior-preserving refactor has not made collection identity or row scanning worse.

[x] SSI-1.3 — Isolation And Closeout

  • [x] Run focused report, manage bridge/controller, inventory, CSS/module, and public read-only checks.
  • [x] Verify no public entrypoint imports the controller, management client, mutation workflow, package workflow, or manage stylesheet.
  • [x] Run the maintained Docs Viewer profile at the integration boundary.
  • [x] Review the final diff independently and record exact tested and untested surfaces.
  • [x] Update durable Reports/Sub-Scope Index owners with only the shipped contribution contract.

Completion Gate

Complete. Existing public and manage behavior remains truthful, the optional contribution seam is independently usable by SSI-2 and SSI-3, and no new workflow is presented as available.

Verification

  • Focused sub-scope module smoke covers optional/empty row and toolbar hosts, lifecycle order, refresh, remount/unmount, missing Status, non-viewable rows, empty and failed inventories, stale detail requests, invalid/mismatched detail identity, manage bridge projection, and unchanged public rows.
  • Public runtime boundary pytest passed 8 passed with an isolated test-owned Projects base.
  • The public read-only route smoke and real manage-service route smoke passed.
  • docs-viewer-smoke passed all 22 maintained checks: var/admin/test-runs/ssi1-report-contribution-final/summary.md.
  • Live Analysis tags review covered the 248-row list and validated detail at ordinary and 760px widths with no blank contribution hosts or horizontal overflow.

The current live tags inventory has no Status-bearing rows, so live visual review did not display a Status icon. Exact icon count, order, accessible labels, missing-Status behavior, and non-viewable behavior are covered by the focused manage contribution fixtures; the icon classes and data source are unchanged.
